summary: Institutional positioning is centered on massive, long-term volatility hedging and extreme directional bets on the SPX, characterized by heavy accumulation in both 7000C and 8000P strikes for late 2026 and 2027. Significant directional conviction is evident in the massive $947.6M buy into SPX 7000C (Dec 2026) and the persistent, multi-day buildup of $3.9B in that same strike, suggesting a long-term bullish bias despite heavy put buying. Traders should monitor the SPX 8000P (Dec 2026) for signs of tail-risk hedging, as $3B+ has been accumulated over 4 sessions, and watch for continued aggressive call buying in AMD (P/C 0.28) and AAPL (P/C 0.05) which signal intense short-term bullish momentum.
